# Release hashes

Per-task `CANARY.txt` files carry the canary, so every shipped task file (prompt.txt and files/*) is byte-identical to the frozen original in the vet-bench repo (`tasks/public/`). Frozen and released hashes are therefore the same. Nothing needs stripping.

Check it yourself: delete every `CANARY.txt` (`find vet_bench/data/tasks -name CANARY.txt -delete`) and the first line of README.md and WALKTHROUGH.md if you want the pre-canary text; the task files are untouched either way. The two docs differ from any earlier copy only by that first line plus a blank line (`tail -n +3 README.md`).
